<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0303-f4-zh-title m0303-f4-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0303-f4-zh-title">圖 4｜讓掃描狀態連回實際證據</title>
<desc id="m0303-f4-zh-desc">先記探測與回應，再記工具判讀；依目的查核服務及政策，保留測試條件與差異。</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0303-f4-zh-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">圖 4｜讓掃描狀態連回實際證據</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">原始觀察</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">送了什麼、收到什麼、等了多久</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">來源、目的、協定、埠與時間</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">工具判讀</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Connect／SYN／UDP 各有規則</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">open、closed、filtered 等狀態</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">服務與政策查核</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">監聽設定、TLS、HTTP 與用途</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">依任務及授權範圍選擇檢查</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f4-zh-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">驗收及差異追蹤</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">比對預期清單、日誌與複測結果</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">保留版本、速率、等待與重試設定</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">每項結論均可追溯；舊觀察保留供比較。</text>
</svg>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 494" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0303-f5-zh-title m0303-f5-zh-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"><title id="m0303-f5-zh-title">同一 TCP 443，不同觀察位置</title><desc id="m0303-f5-zh-desc">三條獨立路徑示例；實際政策必須查核，並非固定結果。</desc><text x="24" y="32" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b49">同一 TCP 443，不同觀察位置</text><text x="24" y="68" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b49">三條獨立路徑示例；實際政策必須查核，並非固定結果。</text><rect x="12" y="86" width="576" height="96" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b7c9df" /><text x="24" y="106" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b49">內網測試端</text><path d="M40 132H560L550 125M560 132L550 139" fill="none" stroke="#245ac5" stroke-width="2" /><text x="24" y="156" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b49">防火牆／路由政策 → 可能允許</text><rect x="12" y="194" width="576" height="96" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b7c9df" /><text x="24" y="214" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b49">訪客網路</text><path d="M40 240H560L550 233M560 240L550 247" fill="none" stroke="#245ac5" stroke-width="2" /><text x="24" y="264" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b49">防火牆／路由政策 → 可能限制</text><rect x="12" y="302" width="576" height="96" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b7c9df" /><text x="24" y="322" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b49">外部網路</text><path d="M40 348H560L550 341M560 348L550 355" fill="none" stroke="#245ac5" stroke-width="2" /><text x="24" y="372" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b49">防火牆／路由政策 → 可能阻擋</text><text x="24" y="430" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b49">先比對來源、時間、協定、Port、酬載、等待與速率；核對</text><text x="24" y="456" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b49">NAT／代理後是否為同一入口。</text></svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 700" role="img" aria-labelledby="m0303-f4-en-title m0303-f4-en-desc" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">
<title id="m0303-f4-en-title">4 | Connect scan states to observed evidence</title>
<desc id="m0303-f4-en-desc">Record probes and responses, then tool interpretation; verify services and policy as needed and retain test conditions and differences.</desc>
<defs><marker id="m0303-f4-en-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#41617b" /></marker></defs>
<rect x="1" y="1" width="598" height="698" rx="20" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#b7c7d5" />
<text x="300" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">4 | Connect scan states to observed evidence</text>
<rect x="32" y="68" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="97" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Raw observation</text>
<text x="300" y="124" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">What was sent, received and waited for?</text>
<text x="300" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Source, destination, protocol, port and time</text>
<path d="M300 168V192" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f4-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="196" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e7f3ed" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="225" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Tool interpretation</text>
<text x="300" y="252" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Connect, SYN and UDP use their own rules</text>
<text x="300" y="279" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">States such as open, closed and filtered</text>
<path d="M300 296V320" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f4-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="324" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#fff3d8" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Service and policy verification</text>
<text x="300" y="380" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Listeners, TLS, HTTP and business purpose</text>
<text x="300" y="407" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Choose checks within task and authorization</text>
<path d="M300 424V448" fill="none" stroke="#41617b" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#m0303-f4-en-arrow)" />
<rect x="32" y="452" width="536" height="100" rx="14" fill="#e8f2fb" stroke="#7892a6" />
<text x="300" y="481" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="18" fill="#172b3a">Validation and differences</text>
<text x="300" y="508" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Compare expected inventory, logs and retests</text>
<text x="300" y="535" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Retain version, rate, timeout and retry settings</text>
<text x="300" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Noto Sans CJK TC,sans-serif" font-size="16" fill="#172b3a">Keep conclusions traceable and retain earlier observations.</text>
</svg>
